### Flashdancer (G4)

**Who she is.** A cheerful-looking **Earth-pony mare** recognizable as the mint-aqua dancer with a towering, curly pink mane, purple eyes, white sweatbands and headband, lime-green top, and a **yellow-star cutie mark**. She dances at DJ Pon-3’s Club Pony Party Palace in *The Saddle Row Review* (season 6, episode 9). The [G4 Earth-pony character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) documents her appearance and design.

**Names.** **Flashdancer** is her community/fandom name, not a spoken show name; its original coiner is unverified. Gameloft instead uses **Athletic Dancer** for the same pony in its licensed *My Little Pony* mobile game (introduced in update 3.7), grouping her with *Hyped-Up Dancer* and *Ecstatic Dancer*. See the [Athletic Dancer game entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Athletic_Dancer).

**Appearances and voice.** Beyond the club scene, she joins Pinkie Pie’s aerobics class in Hasbro’s 2018 *Established 1983* short **“Pinkercise w/ Pinkie Pie!”** and appears on Enterplay’s *Defenders of Equestria* card **“Ravers, Glowsticks Optional”** (#32 R). The [animated-short episode guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/My_Little_Pony_Established_1983) records the Pinkercise appearance. **No individual speaking lines or verified voice-actor credit** have been established; Pinkie does the talking in the short. No confirmed alter ego.
